sources.snippet: The preprocessing pipeline for the Carnatic music dataset is designed to prepare the audio data for feature extraction and model training. One key aspect of this pipeline involves customizing the feature extraction process to capture the nuanced melodic structures and tonal intricacies characteristic of Carnatic music.

sources.title: Carnatic Swara Recognition AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: Carnatic music uses 13 distinct swaras (notes) within each octave, defined relative to a singer's tonic (Sa).
